title: Population density
description: Population density across European regions, expressed as inhabitants per square kilometre.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat demo_r_d3dens. Population density is population divided by regional area. The normaliser keeps every code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract at the levels this dataset declares, NUTS 2 and NUTS 3, and each level carries the values Eurostat publishes for it rather than values derived from another level. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la densita di popolazione piu alta?
caveats: Annual regional density is not a real-time population count.

indicator.name: Population density
indicator.description: Annual population density of the region.

title: Median age of population
description: Median age of the resident population across European regions.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat demo_r_pjanind3 with demographic indicator MEDAGEPOP and unit YR. The normaliser keeps every code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract at the levels this dataset declares, NUTS 2 and NUTS 3, and each level carries the values Eurostat publishes for it rather than values derived from another level — which matters here, because a median cannot be aggregated from its parts. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la popolazione piu anziana?
caveats: Median age is not the arithmetic mean age.

indicator.name: Median age of population
indicator.description: Age that divides the population into two numerically equal groups.

title: GDP per capita in PPS relative to the EU average
description: Regional GDP per capita in purchasing power standards, expressed as a percentage of the EU27 average.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat nama_10r_2gdp using unit PPS_HAB_EU27_2020. This table already represents GDP and does not expose an na_item dimension. It publishes no NUTS 3, so the dataset declares NUTS 2 alone; the normaliser keeps every NUTS 2 code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni hanno il PIL pro capite piu alto rispetto alla media UE?
caveats: Values are an index where the EU27 average equals 100, not currency amounts.

indicator.name: GDP per capita in PPS
indicator.description: GDP per inhabitant in PPS relative to the EU27 average (EU=100).

title: Unemployment rate
description: Annual unemployment rate for people aged 15–74 across European regions.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat tgs00010 selecting all education levels, total sex, age 15–74 and percentage unit. This is a Eurostat regional aggregate published at NUTS 2 only, so the dataset declares NUTS 2 alone; the normaliser keeps every NUTS 2 code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Dove e piu alta la disoccupazione regionale in Europa?
caveats: The rate covers people aged 15-74 and is an annual survey estimate.

indicator.name: Unemployment rate
indicator.description: Unemployed people as a percentage of the labour force, age 15–74.

title: Crude rate of total population change
description: Annual total population change relative to average population, expressed per 1,000 inhabitants.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat tgs00099 using indicator GROWRT: total population change divided by average population, multiplied by 1,000. This is a Eurostat regional aggregate published at NUTS 2 only, so the dataset declares NUTS 2 alone; the normaliser keeps every NUTS 2 code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee stanno perdendo popolazione?
caveats: The value is a crude annual rate per 1,000 inhabitants, not an absolute count.

indicator.name: Crude rate of total population change
indicator.description: Total population change during the year per 1,000 inhabitants.

title: Nights spent in tourist accommodation
description: Annual nights spent by domestic and foreign guests in tourist accommodation establishments across European regions.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat tour_occ_nin2 selecting total guest residence, number unit and NACE group I551-I553. The table is titled by NUTS 2 region and its response carries NUTS 3 as well; the normaliser keeps every code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract at the levels this dataset declares, NUTS 2 and NUTS 3, each with the values Eurostat publishes for it. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee registrano piu notti turistiche?
caveats: Counts cover reported tourist accommodation establishments, not all visitor nights.

indicator.name: Nights spent
indicator.description: Total nights spent in hotels, short-stay accommodation and camping.
